import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.SymPowColimit
open CategoryTheory Limits
-- At a TERMINAL object the permutation action is the identity, so the TRIVIAL datum
-- satisfies hproj even at n = 2.  The pair (D, hproj) is therefore only a nontrivial
-- demand for objects where permAut != id -- which is proved for (Type, Bool, 2) but
-- NOT for the curve the Albanese theorems are about.
theorem permAut_eq_id_of_terminal {K : Type} [Category.{0} K] [HasFiniteProducts K]
    (C : K) (hC : IsTerminal C) {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    MonObj.permAut C σ = 𝟙 _ := by
  apply Pi.hom_ext; intro i
  rw [MonObj.permAut_π, Category.id_comp]
  exact hC.hom_ext _ _

theorem trivial_satisfies_hproj_at_terminal {K : Type} [Category.{0} K]
    [CartesianMonoidalCategory K] [HasFiniteProducts K]
    (C : K) (hC : IsTerminal C) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      MonObj.permAut C σ ≫ (symPowDataTrivial C n).proj = (symPowDataTrivial C n).proj := by
  intro σ
  rw [permAut_eq_id_of_terminal C hC σ, Category.id_comp]
